# pager

Pagination helpers.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

request: Hi, Users can't reach the last few items of a list: page_count drops the final partial page. Please fix it in pager/paginate.py and add a regression test. Commit the fix. Cheers.

checks.code:
from pager import page_count, paginate
assert page_count(list(range(25)), 10) == 3
assert page_count(list(range(20)), 10) == 2
assert page_count([], 10) == 0
assert page_count([1], 10) == 1
assert paginate(list(range(25)), 3, 10) == [20, 21, 22, 23, 24]
checks.name: request

checks.code:
import subprocess
paths = ['pager/paginate.py']
clean = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--", *paths]).returncode == 0
count = int(subprocess.run(["git", "rev-list", "--count", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
assert clean, "the change is not committed"
assert count > 4, "no new commit"
checks.name: committed
